description: Trucks that pinged within radius_m meters of a point (lat, lon as decimal degrees) between start and end (ISO-8601 UTC). Returns truck_id, the ping time (@timestamp) and the distance in meters, nearest first. Use it to check which truck was physically at a fuel station or toll plaza when a charge was made.

configuration.query: FROM telematics_log | WHERE @timestamp >= ?start AND @timestamp <= ?end | EVAL dist_m = ST_DISTANCE(location, TO_GEOPOINT(CONCAT("POINT(", TO_STRING(?lon), " ", TO_STRING(?lat), ")"))) | WHERE dist_m < ?radius_m | SORT dist_m ASC | KEEP truck_id, @timestamp, dist_m | LIMIT 20

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (negative in Texas), e.g. -96.9036
